after: <!-- Magisk removal uses its Manager or a verified stock backup. -->

before:
<button style="actionbar">
				<placement x="%ab_btn1_x%" y="%ab_y%" placement="4"/>
				<condition var1="rmm_type" var2="magisk"/>
				<condition var1="fileexists" var2="%fox_magisk_path%/%fox_magisk_uninstaller%"/>
				<action function="set">install_back=modules_mount</action>
				<action function="page">mod_unmagisk</action>
			</button>

			<image>
				<condition var1="rmm_type" var2="magisk"/>
				<condition var1="fileexists" var2="%fox_magisk_path%/%fox_magisk_uninstaller%"/>
				<placement x="%ab_btn1_x%" y="%ab_y%" placement="4"/>
				<image resource="actionbar_delete"/>
			</image>
after: <!-- Magisk removal uses its Manager or a verified stock backup. -->

before:
# Darth9
#
# make sure that the nano config directory is copied for nano
ifeq ($(OF_USE_NANO_EDITOR),1)
	LOCAL_POST_INSTALL_CMD += \
	mkdir -p $(TARGET_OUT_ETC)/; \
	mkdir -p $(TARGET_RECOVERY_ROOT_OUT)/system/etc/; \
	cp -rf $(TARGET_OUT_ETC)/nano $(TARGET_RECOVERY_ROOT_OUT)/system/etc/;
endif
after:
# The recovery variant installs nano, its recovery ncurses dependency and
# its own /system/etc/nano configuration, including the rewritten nanorc paths.
ifeq ($(OF_USE_NANO_EDITOR),1)
LOCAL_REQUIRED_MODULES += nano_recovery
endif

<string name="fm_edit_file">Edit File in nano</string>
		<string name="nano_terminal_busy">Close the current terminal session before opening a file in nano.</string>

<string name="fm_edit_file">Редактировать в nano</string>
